# Accessibility review checklist

Use this generated checklist with the source trace and confidence level; it is not a compliance certificate.

- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0001 — Let people enlarge text and icons using Dynamic Type or an equivalent custom control. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0002 — When using custom type styles, follow the target platform's recommended default and minimum sizes. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0003 — Provide sufficient contrast between foreground text or icons and their backgrounds in every supported appearance. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0004 — Favor system-defined colors when the documented conditions apply. (SHOULD, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0005 — Apply the documented Accessibility guidance to convey information with more than color alone. (SHOULD, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0006 — Apply the documented Accessibility guidance to describe your app’s interface and content for VoiceOver. (SHOULD, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0007 — Ensure the experience accommodates text-based ways to enjoy audio and video. (SHOULD, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0008 — Consider pairing information-bearing audio cues with matching haptics. (MAY, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0009 — Apply the documented Accessibility guidance to augment audio cues with visual cues. (SHOULD, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0010 — Size interactive controls for comfortable selection using the target platform's default and minimum dimensions. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0011 — Evaluate whether spacing between controls as important as size is appropriate for the current context. (MAY, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0012 — Ensure the experience accommodates simple gestures for common interactions. (SHOULD, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0013 — Make alternatives to gestures available when applicable. (SHOULD, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0014 — Preserve people’s ability to use Voice Control to give guidance and enter information verbally. (SHOULD, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0015 — Ensure the experience accommodates mobility-related assistive technologies. (SHOULD, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0016 — Preserve people’s ability to use the keyboard alone to navigate and interact with your app. (SHOULD, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0017 — Ensure the experience accommodates switch Control. (SHOULD, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0018 — Maintain actions simple and intuitive. (SHOULD, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0019 — Apply the documented Accessibility guidance to minimize use of time-boxed interface elements. (SHOULD, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0020 — Evaluate whether offering difficulty accommodations in games is appropriate for the current context. (MAY, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0021 — Preserve people’s ability to control audio and video playback. (SHOULD, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0022 — Apply the documented Accessibility guidance to allow people to opt out of flashing lights in video playback. (SHOULD, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0023 — Apply the documented Accessibility guidance to be cautious with fast-moving and blinking animations. (SHOULD, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0024 — Apply the documented Accessibility guidance to optimize your app’s UI for Assistive Access. (SHOULD, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0025 — Apply the documented Accessibility guidance to prioritize comfort. (SHOULD, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0026 — Account for font weight when choosing readable custom text sizes. (SHOULD, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0027 — Integrate with Siri and Shortcuts so people can perform important or repetitive tasks using voice alone. (SHOULD, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0028 — Use tighter animation springs to reduce bounce effects. (SHOULD, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0029 — Keep animations directly with people’s gestures synchronized. (SHOULD, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0030 — Exclude animating depth changes in z-axis layers from the applicable experience. (AVOID, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0031 — Substitute transitions in x-, y-, and z-axes with fades to avoid motion. (SHOULD, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0032 — Exclude animating into and out of blurs from the applicable experience. (AVOID, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0033 — Identify the app's core functionality and consider removing noncritical workflows and interface elements from Assistive Access. (MAY, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0034 — Break multistep Assistive Access workflows into screens that focus on one interaction at a time. (SHOULD, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0035 — Require two confirmation steps before people perform an action that is difficult to recover from. (MUST, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0036 — Keep interface elements within a person's field of view and prefer comfortable horizontal layouts. (SHOULD, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0037 — Reduce the speed and intensity of animated objects, especially in peripheral vision. (SHOULD, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0038 — Use gentle camera and video motion, preserving the person's sense of control over world movement. (SHOULD, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0039 — Avoid anchoring content to the wearer's head when it can cause confinement or impede assistive technologies. (AVOID, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ACCESSIBILITY-0040 — Minimize large and repetitive gestures that can become tiring or difficult in a person's surroundings. (SHOULD, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/accessibility))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-INCLUSION-0001 — Evaluate whether the tone of your copy from different perspectives is appropriate for the current context. (MAY, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/inclusion))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-INCLUSION-0002 — Exclude using specialized or technical terms without defining them from the applicable experience. (AVOID, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/inclusion))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-INCLUSION-0003 — Consider whether humor is appropriate across the cultures, interpretations, and repeated-use contexts you support. (MAY, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/inclusion))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-INCLUSION-0004 — Exclude images and language that exclude people with disabilities from the applicable experience. (AVOID, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/inclusion))
- [ ] HIG-FOUNDATIONS-INCLUSION-0005 — Apply the documented Inclusion guidance to prioritize simplicity and perceivability. (SHOULD, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/inclusion))
- [ ] HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-VOICEOVER-0001 — Make alternative labels for all key interface elements available when applicable. (SHOULD, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/voiceover))
- [ ] HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-VOICEOVER-0002 — Apply the documented VoiceOver guidance to describe meaningful images. (SHOULD, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/voiceover))
- [ ] HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-VOICEOVER-0003 — Apply the documented VoiceOver guidance to make charts and other infographics fully accessible. (SHOULD, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/voiceover))
- [ ] HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-VOICEOVER-0004 — Choose or apply titles and headings to help people navigate your information hierarchy in the documented context. (SHOULD, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/voiceover))
- [ ] HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-VOICEOVER-0005 — Ensure the experience accommodates the VoiceOver rotor when possible. (SHOULD, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/voiceover))
- [ ] HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-VOICEOVER-0006 — Apply the documented VoiceOver guidance to be mindful that custom gestures aren’t always accessible. (SHOULD, medium; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/voiceover))
- [ ] HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-VOICEOVER-0007 — Specify element grouping, order, and links so VoiceOver communicates relationships that are otherwise visual. (SHOULD, high; [source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/voiceover))
